parties: Zensar Technologies Limited (India) / Zensar Technologies Inc. (US); M3BI LLC
headline: Zensar Technologies merger with M3BI LLC intimated to NSE
sum: Zensar Technologies intimated the NSE of the merger of M3BI LLC with Zensar Technologies Inc. (US-domiciled subsidiary), reported via exchange filing on 14 August 2026.
implication: Cross-border M&A involving a US subsidiary of an India-listed entity requires parallel disclosure to domestic stock exchanges; the bare intimation suggests a completed or near-final transaction structure, though terms remain undisclosed.
detail: Zensar Technologies Limited notified the NSE of a merger between M3BI LLC and its US-domiciled subsidiary, Zensar Technologies Inc. The transaction was intimated via NSE's corporate updates channel on 14 August 2026. No transaction value, deal terms, conditions precedent, or strategic rationale are disclosed in the filing. The intimation does not indicate whether the merger has completed or remains subject to approvals.
